nodes.name: Parse Change Set + Build Adversarial Review

parameters.jsCode:
const s=$json; const instructions='You are the single bounded repair stage of a governed coding campaign. Apply only the concrete adversarial findings. Return STRICT JSON only with keys task_id,summary,confidence,operations. Never broaden scope, never weaken tests or guardrails, never authorize yourself, and never emit shell commands or credentials. Stay within the original task path constraints.';
return [{json:{...s,openai_payload:{model:s.model,instructions,input:JSON.stringify({task:s.task,plan:s.plan,previous_change_set:s.change_set,review_findings:s.initial_review.findings,repair_instructions:s.initial_review.repair_instructions,repo_context:s.repo_context}),reasoning:{effort:'high'},max_output_tokens:12000,store:false}}}];

const s=$json; const review=s.final_review||s.initial_review||{}; return [{json:{ok:false,status:'human_escalation_required',task:s.task||null,review:{verdict:review.verdict||'escalate',findings:review.findings||[]},note:'No campaign dispatch occurred.'}}];
